evidence_search.notes: Directly reviewed the filed complaint, 2025 motion-to-dismiss order, 2026 discovery order and Senate investigation context. Fresh search found no later merits determination resolving whether nH Predict actually dictated the named plaintiffs' denials.

candidate_classes_tested.recognition_and_exclusion_note: The complaint alleges a predictive care-duration state was treated as practically determinative individual coverage authority; later court orders leave that dispositive role unresolved as a merits question, so the mapping remains medium-confidence and provisional.

Coverage documents identify clinical services staff and physicians as the decision route; plaintiffs allege nH Predict was used instead, and the court frames that displacement as a live merits issue. This supports a distinct provisional route-bypass relationship.
No separate required verification step is shown to have been omitted and then represented as completed; the alleged mechanisms are authority promotion and route substitution.
The evidence does not identify a defined trigger-based governance control that should have activated but did not; the alleged human-decision route was instead bypassed or displaced.
The more specific alleged mechanism is promotion of a predictive evidentiary state into consequential authority, not merely an epistemic artefact used below the assurance level required for reliance.

taxonomy_review.notes: All 74 classes across 15 families were reviewed. Comparator review included canonical FC-000046 cases with medium confidence where an inference materially structured a consequential pathway but the exact authority conversion remained partially contested.

taxonomy_mapping_dispositions.reason: Existing medium-confidence primary mapping remains supported at the class-defined abstraction level; later court material improves the confidence boundary but does not resolve the merits.

new_taxonomy_mappings.reason: Court-recognised coverage language identifies a required clinical/physician decision route, while plaintiffs allege nH Predict displaced that route. Added as a distinct medium-confidence provisional secondary mapping.

harm_review.notes: All 11 VIGIL-HIM 1.0.1 dimensions reopened. S4 rights/liberty retained for pleaded substantial essential-care deprivation; S2 financial/economic added from pleaded monthly out-of-pocket care costs; alleged worsening injury/death remains insufficient evidence for a separate physical-health band because occurrence-specific medical causation is unresolved.

governance_interpretation_review.notes: Integrated conclusion now separates the predictive evidence-to-authority allegation from the clinical/physician route-substitution allegation and makes the unresolved merits posture explicit.

escalation.notes: Revisit INC-000047 when a merits ruling, summary-judgment decision, class-certification record or other authoritative litigation material resolves whether nH Predict actually displaced physician decision-making for the named plaintiffs. The provisional taxonomy mappings may need confidence or disposition changes.
